_comment: A stand-in for PayFast, as a mountebank imposter.
WHY VIRTUALIZE THE PAYMENT PROVIDER AT ALL
The interesting PayFast behaviours are the ones you cannot ask for on demand: an
ITN that arrives twice, an ITN whose signature does not match, a payment that is
declined, a gateway that stops answering mid-checkout. On a real sandbox you wait
for them or you never see them; here they are four predicates.
This is NOT a claim that the integration works against PayFast. The signature
algorithm is pinned separately by the fixture corpus under
src/contracts/payfast, generated by an independent implementation. What this
imposter proves is the other half: that the API's own handling of a callback is
right — that a replay is refused, a bad signature is refused, and a decline is
not silently treated as a success.
The first live transaction remains a real milestone. Nothing here changes that.
